text: Childminder here, I have an 11 year old girl with me overnight. 37.6. Vomited once around 7pm, has kept drinks down since with no problems. Hasn't had a poo in three days and is pretty fed up about it. Colour is normal, lips and skin fine. Weeing normally. Does she need to be seen or can I manage this at home until her mum collects her in the morning? A straight yes or no would help.
